page.layout: One printed page. Headpiece ornament at top, then the title in three lines (heading, subtitle, small capitals). Below it one text column with a large woodcut initial Q at the left. No margin notes. Catchword at the lower right.

main_text.head: ORATIO DE PRAECIPUIS LAUDIB. ET UTILITATIB. PHILOSOPHIÆ POLITICÆ.
main_text.p: Quanquam istas; quas pro isthoc tempore mihi impositas sustineo; partes, haud immerito subterfugere poteram: Magnifice D. Rector, Generosi & Inclyti Domini Barones, Reverendi, Clarissimi, & ornatissimi omnium Facultatum Doctores ac Professores, cæterique genere, doctrina, & eruditione præstantissimi Viri, hospites exoptatissimi, tu denique virtutis ac pietatis, linguarum ac literarum studiosa, & lectissima nobilissimorum ac literatissimorum iuuenum corona: quā-quā istas, aio, quibus nunc defungar, partes, merito renuere ac subterfugere poteram: facit tamen Magnificentiæ, Generositatis, reuerentiæ & humanitatis vestræ (qua me sustento) benignitas: facit eximia venerandi Collegij ac Senatus Philosophici dignitas; meaque Collegis gratificandi facilitas: tui comprimis, Spectatissime Philosophici Ordinis Decane, & ad hunc Actum Procancellarie, D. Doctor Madere, postulati autoritas facit: quin & iustissimæ nouem istorum, quos isthic in medio seorsim locatos spectatis, honestissimorum ac doctissimorum Candidatorum petitionis æquitas facit: Ut in augustam hanc Cathedram ascendere, & laudabile mihi demandatæ provinciæ munus pro virili parte obire; hoc est, nouem illos iam modo renunciatos Philosophiæ Licentiatos supremo Doctoratus seu Magisterij Philosophici honore ac titulo, ve-

page.notes: The initial Q is a woodcut and is read as the first letter of "Quanquam". A small stray printed mark sits at the top right of the page, above the headpiece; it is not text and is left out. The catchword "lut" is the start of "velut". No page number, running head or signature is printed. Macrons on quā, nunc, iuuenum and similar words are kept as printed.
